title: Franchise expansion · Peer cities

anchor.edge: Farm ~15 min from downtown (Callahan / NE FL fringe) — the model to clone
anchor.model: Mobile petting zoo / farm-near-downtown — not coastal mega, not NYC

selection_rules: Prefer Sun Belt / Southeast / mid-size peers to Jax (~0.9M–2.2M MSA)
Rural-friendly fringe where a homestead can sit ~15–30 min from downtown
Event / HOA / school density as qualitative demand proxy — not invented revenue
Exclude coastal megas (NYC, Miami, etc.) and densifying megas where land near-core is unrealistic

excluded_examples.why: Coastal mega · land near-core impossible · not the Jax model
Coastal mega · land cost / zoning crush farm-near-core
Cited as size peer (~2.9M) but densifying fast — land near-core harder than Jax; keep as watchlist not board

cities.metro_vibe: Sun Belt growth · Triangle suburbs · school/HOA dense
cities.why_peer: Closest Census-size peer with expandable rural fringe (Wake Forest, Clayton, Apex) and strong school/HOA event demand — not a coastal mega.
cities.farm_near_core: Strong — fringe still has acreage ~20–30 min from downtown; land cost higher than Jax (honest).

cities.metro_vibe: Plains sprawl · cheap fringe land · family entertainment hungry
cities.why_peer: Pop-band twin with classic rural ring — farm-near-core economics often better than FL; mid-size Sun Belt without coastal mega pressure.
cities.farm_near_core: Excellent — acreage common within ~15–25 min of downtown corridors.

cities.metro_vibe: River city · horse-country fringe · strong schools/events
cities.why_peer: Mid-South size peer; Oldham / Bullitt / southern Indiana fringe fits mobile zoo + homestead-near-core; event/HOA density solid.
cities.farm_near_core: Strong — rural belts sit ~15–30 min from downtown without coastal land crush.

cities.why_peer: Mid-size SE-adjacent peer with layered suburbs + school calendars; fringe still agrarian enough for a Callahan-style site.
cities.farm_near_core: Good — Hanover / Chesterfield west still support ~20–30 min farm-to-downtown runs.

cities.pop_band_vs_jax: mid peer (~1.3M) — Jax.gov cites as size peer
cities.metro_vibe: Delta hub · DeSoto MS / Fayette TN fringe farms
cities.why_peer: Official Jax size-peer cite; cross-state fringe (esp. DeSoto) keeps farm-near-core realistic; school + church event density is a workable starter proxy.
cities.farm_near_core: Strong — MS/TN fringe acreage often ~20–30 min from downtown cores.

cities.metro_vibe: SE inland · Shelby/St. Clair growth rings
cities.why_peer: Southeast climate/culture cousin; Shelby County fringe supports homestead + HOA/school density without coastal mega competition.
cities.farm_near_core: Strong — rural belts remain within ~15–30 min of downtown/southside corridors.

cities.pop_band_vs_jax: stretch UP (~2.2M) — Jax.gov cites as peer
cities.why_peer: Jax's own peer cite and strong event/HOA/school demand — but larger and hotter land market than Callahan model.
cities.farm_near_core: Mixed / stretch — fringe still exists (Robertson, Rutherford west) but ~15-min downtown farms are rarer/costlier than Jax.
cities.stretch_note: Larger boomtown; land near-core is the risk, not demand.

cities.why_peer: Fast SE mid-market with school/HOA density and rural fringe toward Anderson/Pickens — franchise ladder rung below Jax size.
cities.farm_near_core: Strong — acreage still available ~20–30 min from downtown Greenville.

cities.metro_vibe: Valley city · family tourism spill · rural rings
cities.why_peer: Honest smaller SE market; farm-near-core is easy and family tourism helps Violet — demand density lower than Jax.
cities.farm_near_core: Excellent — rural fringe commonly ~15–25 min from downtown.
cities.stretch_note: Smaller pop band; good ops fit, thinner enterprise density.

cities.metro_vibe: Mid-size Sun Belt · cheap fringe · event calendar room
cities.why_peer: Farm-near-core economics mirror Jax edge better than coastal peers; size is smaller so treat as ladder market, not clone.
cities.farm_near_core: Excellent — homestead sites often ~15–25 min from downtown.
cities.stretch_note: Smaller MSA; strong land fit, thinner absolute TAM.

notes: No invented revenue, franchisees, or signed LOIs — status=research for all peers.
Starter segments map to GTM seats: enterprise · subscription · violet (B2C).
Pop figures are approximate Census 2025 MSA estimates for peer banding — not diligence-grade.
